description: This PHP class 'MyTrackerAPI' is part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically within the Performance plugin API namespace. It defines an API endpoint for listing performance trackers associated with the authenticated user, implementing the CRUD endpoint interface but with only the 'getAll' method operational. The class leverages traits for authentication and service access, and utilizes Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation. Its primary role is to handle HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of performance tracker data, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.
